SASBDB entry SASDF29  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDF29/)

Publication: Staufen1 reads out structure and sequence features in ARF1 dsRNA for target recognition.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkz1163

The files are the SASBDB downloads, unchanged:
  experimental_data/SASDF29.dat   the curve (q in 1/A; columns q, I, error; no header)
  SASDF29_fit1.fit                the CRYSOL fit (q in 1/A; columns q, Iexp, Ierr, Icalc)
  SASDF29_fit1_model1.pdb         the CYANA 3.97 NMR bundle of "fit1": 20 MODEL records

The publisher's PDF is not kept here; fetch it from the DOI above. The fitting script
test/fitting_tests/SASDF29/ cites what it takes from the SASBDB entry.
